mainEntity.name: How long does basement ceiling framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the basement layout, the number of obstacles overhead, and whether the ceiling is being framed as part of a full finish. More complex runs around HVAC, plumbing, and beams take longer because the framing has to be leveled, blocked, and fitted carefully before drywall or ceiling panels go up.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple basement ceiling framing job can move quickly, but hidden utilities, soffits, and level adjustments usually add time. The more cutouts and transitions you have, the longer it takes.
